notes_for_editor: Conflicts left in the text: shoal length (NRHP 3,000 yd vs Lighthousefriends 1,000 yd); date of permanent light (LHF 15 Feb 1913 vs NRHP superstructure complete 20 Feb 1913); end of keepers (NRHP 1975 vs LHF/DBLHKFA 1973); builder of shell (foundry vs Tatnall-Brown); Holland's departure date (Chronicle 29 Dec vs Ledger 30 Dec; Chronicle four days/three nights vs Ledger three days). Newspaper pages read through OCR; Ledger text is badly OCR'd. Cape Gazette gives Maull dates 1737-1780 (not used beyond 1780). NRHP listing year 1991 from Lighthousefriends; form is dated Aug 1989. Bulletin 1927 exposition not named in the text read (index says Philadelphia Exposition). The 1915 Commissioner quote was matched from corpus snippet; scan p.58 is printed p.53. Lighthousefriends and DBLHKFA are copyrighted: facts only, paraphrased.
